# SiteScoper

> AI website audit tool: paste a URL and get a scored report on UX, SEO, copy, conversion and speed in about 60 seconds, with fixes ranked by impact. First audit is free with no account.

SiteScoper crawls up to 8 of a site's most important pages and uses frontier AI models to produce opinionated, prioritized recommendations rather than a 200-row checklist. Built for founders, indie hackers, marketers and small agencies. Pro ($19/month) adds unlimited audits, weekly Site Watch monitoring, Competitor Radar, PDF export and white-label reports. A $9 one-time Audit & Fix Pass unlocks generated fixes and 30 days of monitoring for a single site.

## Free tools

- [Free tools](/tools): Index of SiteScoper's free, no-signup utilities.
- [Open Graph & meta tag checker](/tools/open-graph-checker): Preview how a link renders on Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Slack and WhatsApp; validates real image size and weight and generates corrected head tags.
- [llms.txt generator](/tools/llms-txt-generator): Builds a spec-compliant llms.txt from a site's sitemap and page metadata.
